staff.title: On-duty IT staff
staff.description: If your PC won't start, the screen is blank, or printing fails, call the matching specialist by extension:

tips.title: 3 quick self-help tips
tips.intro: Try these simple steps — you may recover without waiting in queue:
tips.tip1Body: Press F5 once to refresh. If still stuck, press Ctrl + F5.
tips.tip2Body: Check paper tray, then power the printer off, wait 10 seconds, and turn it back on.
tips.tip3Body: Check the blue LAN cable at the back of the PC for a blinking light. On Wi-Fi, toggle Wi-Fi off and on.

form.step1Hint: Employee details are prefilled. Edit them if you are reporting for a colleague.
form.name: Full name
form.extensionHint: So IT can call you back
form.step2Hint: Pick the closest match so we can assign the right specialist.
form.step3Hint: Include on-screen messages so technicians can prepare tools and parts.
form.ticketTitleHint: Mention the app and symptom briefly
form.ticketTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Add sales Excel export button or Accounting app shows Error...
form.ticketDetailHint: More detail means faster fixes with fewer follow-up questions.
form.ticketDetailPlaceholder: Describe timing, error text, or for feature requests: purpose, expected result, and departments involved...
form.dropzoneTitle: Drag an image here or press Ctrl + V to paste
form.dropzoneHint: PNG, JPG up to 10MB (click this area to browse files)
form.priorityNormalHint: Other work can continue; production not blocked
form.priorityUrgentHint: Month-end close, urgent billing, or customer service blocked
form.submitHint: After submit you will get a Ticket ID and can track status immediately.
